_meta.name: Data Entry Keyers Employed
_meta.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (SOC 43-9021)
_meta.note: National employment from the OEWS national workbook for each May (TOT_EMP, detailed occupation). BLS cautions that OEWS estimates are not designed for year-to-year comparison: the survey pools three years of samples, and model-based (MB3) estimation began with May 2021. Values read from the seven national workbooks (2019–2025) and checked in with each file's hash.
